BombVault now tells you when a backup looks wrong, not only when it fails.

## ✨ Added

- **Anomalies.** Every backup of a container, VM, folder set, database dump, the flash drive and the self-backup is compared with its own history. Reported: much more new data than usual, most of the data stored again, a source or dump that is suddenly almost empty or much smaller, far fewer files, a much slower restic run, repeated or intermittent failures, a restore check that stopped passing, and a disk that will be full soon.
- **Existing installs do not start from zero.** Sizes, file counts and restic durations are read once from the snapshots restic 0.17 already stores.
- **Old backups are kept when data is lost.** When a source shrinks sharply, or one backup stores most of the data again, BombVault keeps that item's old backups until you acknowledge the anomaly, so an emptied or encrypted folder cannot push the good backups out one night at a time. The anomaly links to the last good backup, and the restore panel marks the backup it was raised on.
- **Where you see it.** A dashboard card, an Anomalies page with filters and bulk acknowledge, a badge and a learning indicator on every item, a mark on the runs in the history and the activity log, and a card on Settings, Integrity for the sensitivity (Strict, Balanced, Permissive) and the notification minimum, which each item can override.
- **Notifications for critical anomalies**, sent once per episode through the channels you already use. Which severities notify is configurable.
- **Backups record restic's own totals** (source size, file count, duration) per run.
- **The recovery kit warns against the newest snapshot after data loss**, since it can be the emptied or encrypted one.

## ⚡ Improved

- **A failed retention step also notifies when the notification policy was never set**, as it counted as "failures only" everywhere else already.

## 🐛 Fixed

- **VM backups with zvol disks count the disks' new data in the run's size.**
